summary: Tested the Marketing module end to end, backend and frontend. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass (tests/test_marketing_v58.py). Covered: auth gating (anonymous, vendor, missing CSRF), contacts list/filter, add, import (lawful_basis 422, missing email column 422, dedupe, consent=no, audience column, invalid row skipped), sync, delete, segment preview counts (consent, unsubscribe, audience, country, category, source), segment create/list/delete, a real Claude AI copy call, the full campaign flow (bad segment 422, draft update, test send email_sent=True, send then sending then sent, second send 409, edit after send 409, mkt_sends rows, open pixel, click redirect for link and CTA, unknown rid goes home, stats), unsubscribe HTML and segment exclusion, tender alerts (disabled sends nothing; enabled publish emails the vendor whose business_categories match plus the consented uploaded contact, skips the unsubscribed and non-consented contacts, recipients=2, one log entry, a second invocation sends 0), and referrals (stable code and link, ref with a lowercase code recorded, unknown code ignored, joined count, admin leaderboard). Frontend: admin login, side nav 'Marketing', all 5 tabs, CSV import via file plus consent checkbox (button disabled until both are present), country filter, segment live size and save, new campaign, AI writer filling subject/body plus preview, save draft, edit, send with confirm dialog, status turning sent, alerts toggle persisted then turned OFF, referrals tab, vendor /vendor/refer (link, copy toast, joined count), /register?ref=CODE sending ref in the createDraft POST. All the requested flows work. One critical latent bug was found in code review: sending a campaign whose segment was deleted emails every consented contact.

critical.issue: If the campaign's segment has been deleted, `seg = find_one(...) or {}` makes _segment_filter({}) return {consent:true, unsubscribed:{$ne:true}}, so the send goes to EVERY consented contact, vendors and buyers, in all countries. DELETE /segments/{id} does not check whether drafts use the segment. Found by code review; not executed, to avoid mass mail.

minor.issue: There is no try/except. If an exception happens mid-send, the campaign stays in 'sending' forever and cannot be retried (send only works on drafts).
New-tender alerts fire only from POST /notices/{ref}/publish. Notices created already published, or auto-published after the hosting fee is paid, never trigger send_tender_alert.

Consent logic: vendors with no registration record get consent=True by default, but vendors who registered get registrations.marketing_consent, which is always False because no UI collects it. Most real vendors therefore sync as 'No consent'. The rule is inconsistent and a GDPR concern either way.

Platform vendors get alerts without any consent check (only an mkt_contacts unsubscribe blocks them). Unsubscribe links appear only if the vendor already exists in mkt_contacts. notice.title is put into the HTML unescaped. The alert log is written after the loop, so two concurrent publishes could double-send.
Re-importing or syncing an existing contact overwrites source, audience and country (for example platform becomes upload), which skews source-based segments.
referred_by is saved on the registration even when the ref code is invalid (record_referral correctly ignores it).

ui_bugs.issue: After a successful import the file input still shows the old file name and the consent checkbox stays ticked. Picking the same file again does not fire onChange.

integration_issues.issue: RegistrationStart reads localStorage 'pmc_ref', but nothing ever writes it. If a visitor lands on /register?ref=X and navigates away before submitting, the referral is lost.

issues: Secondary .pmc-btn buttons ('Add platform vendors & buyers', 'Write draft', 'Save draft', 'Send test') show as plain text with no border or background, so they don't look clickable
The campaign preview pane does not show bullets for <ul>/<li> (the prose classes do not seem to apply)

action_items: In _run_campaign/send_campaign, refuse to send (409/422) when the segment is missing. Never fall back to {}. Block segment delete while draft campaigns reference it.
Wrap _run_campaign in try/except and set status to 'failed' (or back to 'draft') on error
Trigger send_tender_alert from create_notice when is_published=true and from the hosting-fee auto-publish path
Make the sync consent rule consistent (explicit consent field or the same default for all) and collect marketing_consent in the registration UI
Persist ?ref to localStorage('pmc_ref') on landing; reset the import file input and checkbox after import
Style the secondary pmc-btn buttons in the marketing screens; fix list bullets in the preview
critical_code_review_comments: Deleted segment → campaign sends to all consented contacts (marketing.py _run_campaign / send_campaign `or {}`)
Alerts HTML puts notice title and category in without escaping
track_click uses only stored campaign links, so it is not an open redirect. Good.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' returns ACAO '*' (pre-existing, not marketing specific). bcrypt $2b$ hash and httpOnly access_token confirmed.
